message:
docs(field-test): preserve the 0.2.104 17:15-17:22 evidence without naming a cause

The host log covering this run had already rotated to host.log.1, so the
window was excerpted from the NAS originals before it could age out. Records
what the logs show and nothing more: six session-dead closes that match the
viewer watchdog's WM_CLOSE path (not a crash), seven link-silent stretches
with the receive loop still spinning, eleven terminal nack-spent events -- three
of them before the reported HQ switch -- congestion normal across all 373
samples while four recovery requests produced zero recoveries, ABR walking
12 to 9 to 6.6 Mbps, and capture restarts climbing to fourteen.

Each figure is tagged with who confirmed it, and every one was re-checked
against the raw text. Two corrections came out of that: the 17:19:04.297
sample reads queueDepthMax=4, not 9 (9 first appears at 17:19:11.157), and no
log event backs the 17:18:10 HQ switch -- the bitrate was 12 Mbps from session
start -- so it is recorded as the user's timeline only.

The cause of the silence, the bandwidth relationship, and any link to the
11:27 event remain undetermined and are marked as such.

Documentation only -- read-only NAS access, no product change, no build, no
live session touched.
